payload.symptom: Empty .git/HEAD.lock file persists between dev-team cron cycles, ages 12-30+ min, no live git pid holding it. Stale-lock — git operation crashed mid-write or worktree cleanup left orphan.
payload.current_mitigation: Step 0-PREFLIGHT guard (shipped c55 commit 57cbb376) — clears stale lock at cycle start. Symptomatic only.
payload.root_cause_hypothesis: Likely related to SDK worktree cleanup pathology (also c55 escalation 4cea5eeb). Worktree removal sequence leaves .git/HEAD.lock when parent repo is busy. OR: parallel dev-team agent spawns racing on HEAD write during merge gate.
payload.ask: Architect brief for: (1) lock acquisition timeout + retry semantics in dev-team merge gate; (2) at-exit cleanup guarantee for SDK worktree spawns; (3) root cause why HEAD.lock specifically (not index.lock or other) — points to ref update race not index write race.
